
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/halfcode/p/23752260" title="发布于 2026-11-23 11:02">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">22. ArkTS switch语句实战：case、break、default 全面掌握</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p><code style="font-size: 14px">switch</code><span style="font-size: 14px"> 后面跟一个表达式。大括号里写 </span><code style="font-size: 14px">case</code><span style="font-size: 14px">，每个 </span><code style="font-size: 14px">case</code><span style="font-size: 14px"> 后面是一个值和冒号。这个值和表达式对上了，就执行冒号后面的代码，碰到 </span><code style="font-size: 14px">break</code><span style="font-size: 14px"> 就跳出 </span><code style="font-size: 14px">switch</code><span style="font-size: 14px">。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 14px">动画视频在《<a class="name ellipsis" href="https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV14cyxzCEg1/" target="_blank" data-v-3995fb7c="" rel="noopener nofollow">ArkTS switch语句实战：case、break、default 全面掌握</a>》。</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>let day: number = 3<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">switch</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (day) {
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">case</span> 1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
    console.log(</span>'星期一'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">break</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">case</span> 2<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
    console.log(</span>'星期二'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">break</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">case</span> 3<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
    console.log(</span>'星期三'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">break</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">default</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
    console.log(</span>'其他'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p><code>day</code> 是 3，对上 <code>case 3</code>，打出星期三。<code>break</code> 把 <code>switch</code> 结束掉，<code>default</code> 不会再执行。</p>
<p><code>default</code> 是兜底。前面的 <code>case</code> 都没对上，才走这里。可以不写。写的话，通常放在最后。</p>
<p>先开启预览器，再打开日志面板，按 Ctrl + S 保存，才能看到输出。后面的 <code>console.log</code> 也一样。</p>
<div>
<p><img alt="星期三" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1919157/202611/1919157-20261123110018685-1601841016.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h2>break 与贯穿</h2>
<p><code>case</code> 对上之后，这一段要是没写 <code>break</code>，不会停，会接着执行下面的 <code>case</code>。几个值做同一件事，中间的 <code>case</code> 就空着，代码只写在最后一个上面。判断工作日还是周末，就是这么写的。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>let day: number = 6<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">switch</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (day) {
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">case</span> 1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">case</span> 2<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">case</span> 3<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">case</span> 4<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">case</span> 5<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
    console.log(</span>'工作日'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">break</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">case</span> 6<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">case</span> 7<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
    console.log(</span>'周末'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">break</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">default</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
    console.log(</span>'其他'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p><code>day</code> 是 6。<code>case 6</code> 后面没有代码，直接落到 <code>case 7</code>，打出周末，然后 <code>break</code>。</p>
<p>1 到 5 也是这样。<code>case 1</code> 到 <code>case 4</code> 都是空的，一路落到 <code>case 5</code> 那句输出，打出工作日。所以 1 到 5 都是工作日，6 和 7 都是周末。这两个范围以外的数走 <code>default</code>，打出其他。</p>
<p><img alt="工作日和周末" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1919157/202611/1919157-20261123110117479-929228333.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
</div>
